title: Black Cat
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Train Heartnet, once a top assassin for the world-ruling organization Chronos, left after his friend Saya changed his outlook and now works as an easygoing bounty hunter with partner Sven. They rescue Eve, a girl made as a nanotech bio-weapon, and are drawn into a war between Chronos and Creed, the ex-assassin who killed Saya and leads a revolutionary terrorist group (Wikipedia; Viz blurb via AniList).
life_message: A person can leave a killing life behind, choose freedom and mercy, and become family to others.

content.note: Gunfights, assassins, killing of world leaders by Creed's group (Wikipedia); AniList Guns, Assassins; MU Child Assassin.

folkways.japan: A lone gunman who leaves his organization echoes the masterless-samurai (ronin) figure, and friendship and mercy are Weekly Shonen Jump staples.

delivery.evidence: Critics criticized a typical shonen plot (Wikipedia); no mention of preachiness (to verify).

personified.ideology: world peace through a secret ruling organization

delivery.note: Both the revolutionaries and the ruling organization are shown as dangerous, with the hero standing apart from each.

winners_losers: Train, Sven and Eve win and stay free; Creed is defeated but spared. Sympathy goes to independent conscience over both revolution and organized power.
